gyms.name: Gyms & Fitness Centers
gyms.painPoint: Manual admission registers, tracking monthly membership fees on WhatsApp, no workout guidance app
gyms.offerAngle: Custom branded fitness web-app and official Android Mobile App on Google Play Store for membership booking, fee alerts & workout plans

doctors_clinics.name: Doctors, Dentists & Clinics
doctors_clinics.painPoint: Reception phone constantly busy, paying high commission to aggregator apps (Practo), no 1-click booking link
doctors_clinics.offerAngle: Custom clinic website with 1-click appointment booking system and verified Android app on Play Store with automated patient WhatsApp reminders

real_estate.name: Real Estate Brokers & Realtors
real_estate.painPoint: Sending 50 heavy photos and PDFs over WhatsApp which clients lose, no professional property showroom
real_estate.offerAngle: Luxury property portfolio web-app with interactive floor plans, virtual tours & 1-click site visit scheduling on Google Play Store

cafes_restaurants.name: Cafes & Dining Lounges
cafes_restaurants.painPoint: Losing 25% to 30% profit margin on every order to Zomato/Swiggy, lack of customer loyalty program
cafes_restaurants.offerAngle: Direct QR-code table ordering web-app & branded Play Store ordering app so 100% customer payments and data stay with the cafe

coaching_institutes.name: Coaching Classes & Tutors
coaching_institutes.painPoint: Managing student batches and test papers manually, students pirating notes or missing lectures
coaching_institutes.offerAngle: Student learning portal & branded Play Store Android app for secure test series, recorded lectures and student fee tracking
